test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

The Chinese are believed to have a longer history than that of any other civilisation in the wolrd.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Wolrd"** is incorrectly spelt and does not exist in the English dictionary. (गलत वर्तनी)
 
• The correct spelling should be **"World"**, which means the earth, together with all of its countries, peoples, and natural features. (दुनिया)
 
 
• **Example: **The** world** is facing numerous environmental challenges.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Chinese** (चीनी): Relating to China or its language, culture, or people.

 
 
• **Example:** The Chinese New Year is celebrated with dragon dances and fireworks.
 
 
 
• **Civilisation** (सभ्यता): The stage of human social development and organization that is considered most advanced.
 
 
• **Example:** The ancient Egyptian civilisation is known for its pyramids and pharaohs.
 
 
 
• **Believed** (माना जाता है): Accept as true or real.
 
 
• **Example:** She believed in the power of positive thinking.
 
 

46:Tbd4,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
